title: A complete description of solvable symplectic Lie algebras
summary: In this paper, we present a complete characterization of solvable symplectic Lie algebras via a symplectic double extension process. We demonstrate that any such algebra is either symplectically irreducible or can be constructed through a finite sequence of symplectic double extensions by a line or a plane, starting from symplectically irreducible Lie algebras. Furthermore, we show that if a symplectic Lie algebra has a nondegenerate derived ideal, then it is necessarily unimodular and, in particular, solvable.
